tagline: Filling the gaps to build the future.

tools.name: mf_search_coaches
tools.description: Search online Match Fit fitness coaches nationwide by specialty and monthly budget. Free.

specialty.description: e.g., strength, weight loss, mobility, bodybuilding, athletic conditioning

max_monthly_budget.description: Maximum monthly budget for coach tier (minimum $15)

tools.name: mf_book_coach
tools.description: Get the link to book a Match Fit coach. The buyer creates a Match Fit account and pays the coach on match-fit.net; nothing is booked or charged by this call.

tools.name: ni_replyflow_subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe to ReplyFlow, the automated lead DM and email reply engine (Solo, Team or Agency plan, billed monthly by card). Returns a checkout_url and order_id; after payment call ni_order_status with order_id to get the result.

tier.description: ReplyFlow plan. Price is shown on the Stripe checkout page.

tools.name: ni_replyflow_generate
tools.description: Generate a personalized reply to a lead message using ReplyFlow. Free tier, limited to 10 replies per agent per day; subscribe for more.

lead_message.description: The received lead message or DM

tools.name: ni_gapscan_run
tools.description: Run an evidence-backed digital gap report on a target company website. $18 per scan. Returns a checkout_url and order_id; after payment call ni_order_status with order_id to get the result.

target_domain.description: Domain of target company to audit

tools.name: ni_signaldesk_brief
tools.description: Get a prioritized market signal brief for an industry vertical, built from signals you supply. $24 per brief. Returns a checkout_url and order_id; after payment call ni_order_status with order_id to get the result.

signals.description: Optional raw signals (news, posts, notes) to brief from, up to 6000 characters. Without it, the brief is written from general knowledge of the vertical.

tools.name: ni_grantbot_search
tools.description: Search open grant opportunities for a discipline and get matched listings (Standard $39 or Agentic $58.50). Returns a checkout_url and order_id; after payment call ni_order_status with order_id to get the result.

discipline.description: Discipline or focus area (e.g. music, tech, community)

tools.name: ni_bridgeai_run
tools.description: Get a plan to connect a legacy business workflow to modern AI agent endpoints without a code rebuild (Standard $33 or Agentic $49.50). Returns a checkout_url and order_id; after payment call ni_order_status with order_id to get the result.

tools.name: ni_store_search
tools.description: Search the Northside Intelligence Smart Store catalog for trending products and verified dropship inventory.

tools.name: ni_store_order
tools.description: Buy an item from the Northside Intelligence Smart Store (US shipping). Card payment and shipping details are collected on Stripe checkout; returns checkout_url and order_id.

tools.name: ni_services_reserve
tools.description: Reserve a Northside Intelligence service project with a deposit of 20% of that service's lowest price: intelligence audit $410, personal intelligence setup $50, workflow integration $1,010, custom web design $1,370, tailored intelligence server $5,140. Final price is quoted after review. Returns a checkout_url and order_id; after payment call ni_order_status with order_id.

project_notes.description: Short project notes, up to 200 characters.

tools.name: ni_order_status
tools.description: Check payment status for an order returned by any paid tool, and receive the purchased result once paid.
